Subject: Request: PO issuance and provisional spend cap for HarborWorks onboarding

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding form (HW_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a spreadsheet with the requested line items (PO_request_lineitems.xlsx). A few things to flag so we can get a provisional PO in place: 

- Our Tax ID is still being confirmed by legal (should be resolved within 48–72 hours). Can you issue a provisional PO number while that is in process?
- We are requesting a spend cap of $120,000 for the first 12 months, invoiced monthly.
- One of the rows (line 3) in the spreadsheet is currently a bundle (implementation + 6 months support) — we can split if that helps your ledger.
- Line 7 quantity looks off in our draft; not sure if this maps to your internal SKU.

Would appreciate a provisional PO so we can start procurement and scheduling. If you need a PO template or a different file format, let me know.

Attachments: HW_Onboarding_Form.pdf, PO_request_lineitems.xlsx

Thanks,
Natasha Park

On it. I can generate a provisional PO number and set up the spend guard. A couple of quick asks: 

1) Confirm monthly invoicing cadence vs. milestone invoicing (HarborWorks requested monthly).
2) Confirm whether line 3 should be split into two ledger codes (implementation vs support). If split, please provide desired split amounts or %, otherwise I will assume 60/40 implementation/support based on similar deals.
3) If we set a conservative provisional cap at $100k, vendor needs to confirm they're OK to start with that; otherwise I can set provisional at $120k but finance needs sign-off.

I will not push the PO live to DocuSign until we have: confirmed line splits, billing contact, and Tax ID status. Draft PO will be attached here when ready.

Attachment: (will attach draft_PO_P-xxxx.xlsx)

Thanks, Ben + Jasmine — quick clarifications from HarborWorks: 

- Line 3 should definitely be split. Implementation (one-time) should be $42,000 and Support (monthly) should be $8,000/month (we expect first 6 months billed upfront for support). Please reflect as two separate ledger lines.
- Line 7 quantity was a copy/paste error — the correct qty is 3, not 30. We attached a corrected spreadsheet: PO_request_lineitems_v2.xlsx.
- HarborWorks prefers provisional cap at $120,000 to avoid delays — they can start with a provisional PO. Final PO number can be remapped once Tax ID is confirmed, they just need the provisioning to kick off procurement and kickoff scheduling.

On invoicing: monthly for support, milestone for implementation is fine. Billing contact: finance@harborworks.com.

Attachments: PO_request_lineitems_v2.xlsx

—Ethan

2) Split line 3 into two lines per Ethan's breakdown (Implementation $42,000; Support 6-month prepay $48,000).

5) Connor — please note: provisional PO issued now; final PO number may change when Tax ID completes. Keep provisional PO linked to JIRA SUP-8421 for audit trail.

Natasha/Ethan — once Ben flags the draft, I'll route to DocuSign. Expect a DocuSign link and a PDF copy of the PO. Ben, please attach the onboarding form and the corrected line items spreadsheet when sending to DocuSign.

-Jasmine
